flushGroupAggregates compares each registered active axis in configured order using value_extractor(previous/next sort_prop_id) and strict !==; first changed active index triggers flush last→that index. It is adjacent boundary detection, not a global hash GROUPBY.

handleSortBoundary appends those summaries after already accumulated prior rows, before current row append/accumulation. End residuals emit last active axis→first active axis. Disabled-axis boundaries alone do not trigger summary flush.
